manuscript.label: Manuscript
manuscript.failedDraft: Your text was kept separately as a recovery draft. The manuscript file was not changed.
manuscript.reloadHint: Reads the manuscript from disk again. Save unsaved text first.
manuscript.mixed: mixed line breaks — saving uses one style
manuscript.undecodable: This manuscript is not UTF-8 (e.g. saved as CP949/EUC-KR). The file was not changed and autosave is off.
manuscript.undecodableHow: Use “Open file location”, save the file as UTF-8 in Notepad (Save as → Encoding: UTF-8), then press “Read again”.
manuscript.locked: Another program is using the manuscript file, so it cannot be read. Close it or finish saving there, then press “Read again”.
manuscript.draftFound: There is an unsaved recovery draft ({time}).
manuscript.closeHeld: The window was kept open because the manuscript could not be saved. Your text was kept as a recovery draft. Close the window again to close anyway.
manuscript.missing: The manuscript file is gone (deleted or renamed elsewhere). The editor still has your text; autosave is paused.
manuscript.externalLoaded: Loaded changes made elsewhere ({time}). The cursor stayed where it was.

conflict.title: This manuscript was also changed elsewhere
conflict.again: The file changed again while saving. Choose again with the new content.
conflict.restored: Restored a conflict that was not resolved last time
conflict.kept: Your text was kept as a recovery copy. The manuscript file on disk is not changed until you choose.
conflict.diskMissing: The file is gone (deleted or renamed).
conflict.diskUndecodable: It was changed to non-UTF-8 content (e.g. CP949). Its bytes are kept as they are.
conflict.diskLocked: Another program is using it, so it cannot be read. Finish saving there, then press “Check disk again”.
conflict.mineBelow: Your text (my draft) is still in the editor below. Further edits also go into the recovery copy.
conflict.keepMineOverwrite: Overwrite with my draft (saved as UTF-8)
conflict.takeDisk: Use the disk version (discard my draft)
conflict.mergeHow: Lines changed on only one side were applied. Where both sides changed the same lines, both versions are kept between ‘<<<<<<< 앱에서 쓴 내용 / ======= / >>>>>>> 디스크(외부) 내용’ markers. Keep what you want and delete the marker lines.
conflict.markersLeft: Marker lines (<<<<<<< / >>>>>>>) are still there. Resolve them to save.

history.title: Episode commits and history
history.sameRequest: This commit request was already done (r{n}). No new revision was made.
history.noChange: Same text as the previous revision (r{n}); nothing was committed.
history.needResolve: There is a conflict or recovery copy. Resolve it in the editor’s conflict panel first.
history.saveFirstFailed: The manuscript could not be saved first, so nothing was committed. See the editor’s message.
history.notReady: The manuscript is not open or cannot be read, so it cannot be committed.
history.help: A commit keeps the whole manuscript file at that moment as an unchangeable revision (r1, r2…). Unsaved text is saved first, and a change made elsewhere is read from disk first. The same commit request twice makes one revision, and nothing is made if the text equals the previous revision. Comparison ignores the BOM and line-break style (CRLF/LF). Characters are counted as you see them (a composed Hangul syllable or an emoji is 1); line breaks are not counted. Inside changed lines, words, spaces and punctuation are marked.
history.restoreConfirm: Put r{n} into the working copy
history.restored: Restored r{n} into the working copy. History is unchanged; the next commit will be r{next}.
history.problems: Some revision folders cannot be read or do not match their record. They are left out and untouched.
history.identical: Both versions have the same text.

state.noRevision: Before first commit (nothing to check against)

explain.unwritten: No summary yet. Write it below and save.
explain.noRevision: There is a summary, but this episode has no commit, so there is no manuscript version to check it against. Commit the episode in the Episodes tab first.
explain.unreviewed: The summary was never checked against a committed manuscript. If it matches, press “Check as is”.
explain.reviewed: This summary was checked against the newest commit. Saving the manuscript does not change this; a new commit turns it into “Recheck”.
explain.recheck: A new commit was made after the summary was checked. Look at the difference, then edit the summary or check it as is.

summary.uncommitted: The manuscript has changes that are not committed yet. The summary state only changes on a commit.
summary.editedSinceReview: The summary changed after it was checked (possibly outside the app). Editing it never checks it automatically.
summary.dirtyHint: You edited the summary. Use “Save edits and check”, or just save it below.
summary.newerCommit: A newer commit arrived meanwhile. Look at the new state and check again.
summary.changedOutside: The summary file changed outside the app, so it was not saved. Your text is still here.
summary.summaryPlaceholder: What happens in this episode, briefly (your own words)
summary.notePlaceholder: Shown next to the next episode while you write it (never inserted into the manuscript)
summary.prevNote: Note left in episode {n} for the next episode
summary.prevNoteFresh: Note left in episode {n} for the episode you just made

world.problems: {n} card folder(s) could not be read: {dirs}
world.renamed: Renamed. The card ID is unchanged.
world.moved: Moved to “{folder}”. ID, tags and text are unchanged.
world.cardTags: Tags on this card (uncheck = remove from this card only)
world.noTags: No tags yet. Create one in Tags below.
world.tagRemovedFromCard: Removed tag “{tag}” from this card only. Other cards and the tag itself are unchanged.
world.body: Card text (Markdown — questions may stay empty)
world.changedOutside: The card file changed outside the app, so nothing was saved. Your text is still here.
world.tagsHelp: “Hide in view” only hides cards in this list (data unchanged). Remove a tag from one card on the card page; “Clean up everywhere” removes it from every card and deletes the tag.
world.tagRenamed: Tag renamed to “{tag}”. Its ID and cards are unchanged.
world.cleanupImpact: Remove tag “{tag}” from {n} card(s) and delete the tag. Cards and their text are not deleted.
world.cleanupConfirm: Remove from {n} card(s) and delete tag
world.cleanupDone: Removed tag “{tag}” from {n} card(s) and deleted it.

find.title: Find with this card
find.help: “Search names in text” finds the name and aliases literally in manuscripts and shows which matched (no links are made). “Linked episodes” are episodes of events tied to this card.

timeline.name: Timeline name
timeline.noTimelines: No timelines yet. Pick a name and a default view below.
timeline.problems: {n} timeline file(s) could not be read: {paths}
timeline.title: Title
timeline.certaintyLabel: How sure is the story time
timeline.unknownHint: Leave story time empty if you don't know it. The event then needs an episode.
timeline.timelines: Show in timelines (several allowed; one edit updates all)
timeline.changedOutside: The event file changed elsewhere, so nothing was saved. Your input is still here. Close and reopen to see the change.

invalid.titleEmpty: Enter a title. Everything else you typed is kept.
invalid.noCoordinate: Both the episode and the story time are empty. Pick an episode, or set story time to Confirmed or Estimated with a track and a sort number. Your input is kept.
invalid.storyIncomplete: Confirmed or estimated story time needs both a track and a sort number. Pick Unknown if you don't know.
invalid.unknownTrack: That track no longer exists. Pick another.
invalid.episodeOrder: Order in episode must be a number.
invalid.noEpisode: Events without an episode have no manuscript check.
invalid.changeIncomplete: A state change needs both a subject and a property. Remove empty rows.

reviewExplain.noEpisode: Not tied to an episode, so there is no manuscript check.
reviewExplain.noRevision: This episode has no commit to check against.
reviewExplain.unreviewed: This event was never checked against a committed manuscript.
reviewExplain.reviewed: Checked against the newest commit. A new commit will ask for a recheck. Kept apart from the summary check.
reviewExplain.recheck: A new commit arrived after this check. Checking the summary does not clear this.

timeline.newerCommit: A newer commit arrived. Look at it and confirm again.
timeline.tracksHelp: Name tracks like “Main”, “Before the loop”, “Loop 1”. Renaming keeps the track ID and its events.
timeline.deleteImpact: Deletes the event file “{title}”. It disappears from all {n} timeline(s) it is in. Unlike clearing a filter or unticking a timeline, this cannot be undone.
timeline.changesHelp: What this event changes: subject (card) / property / value, e.g. Serin / power / senses embers. Applied in order.
timeline.filterRule: Ranges include both ends (episode numbers, sort numbers). An event shows if it has any included tag (OR); a hidden tag hides it even then. Filters change the view only, never the events.
timeline.linkLabel: Save these conditions as a link
timeline.linkSaved: Saved link “{label}”. It shows above this timeline.
timeline.linkMissing: The link target is gone. It may have been deleted or moved outside the app.
timeline.linkTimelineMissing: Some timelines this link points to no longer exist; their events are not shown.
timeline.deleteLinkImpact: Deletes only the link (saved conditions). Events and timelines stay.
timeline.descBoth: {who} · published by ep. {n} ∩ confirmed up to {track} {x}
timeline.stateHelp: Collects state changes from events and shows the last value per property. Reader basis follows published episodes; story basis follows confirmed positions on one track (estimated and unknown are left out); both is the intersection. Ties go to order in episode, then event ID.
timeline.stateNoEntities: No card has state changes yet. Add them with “+ State change” in an event.
timeline.stateNoProps: No state changes for this subject.
timeline.stateEstimated: Left out because the time is estimated: {list}
timeline.stateNoCardNotes: Card text (free notes) is not mixed into this result.
timeline.pinned: Pinned. Reopen it from “Pinned” above the timeline list.

search.title: Search
search.rules: Three or more characters use the index; one or two characters scan the text directly. Case-insensitive; quotes, % and _ are matched literally. Past versions are included only when ticked.
search.moreHint: Short searches scan in pages. Continue to see the rest.

status.idle: Index: not built yet (built on first search)
status.rebuilding: Rebuilding the index… (generation {gen}) searches use the current index meanwhile
status.error: The index could not be built. Try “Rebuild index”.

search.cacheHint: The index lives outside the work folder (app data); deleting it never touches the work
search.noFts5: This build's SQLite has no FTS5 trigram.
search.unreadable: {n} manuscript(s) that are not UTF-8 are left out of the index.
